plain: To claim back something that was given up or lost

webster.text: To claim back; to demand to have returned.

more.text: To reduce to the state desired.
To recall; to cry out against.
To reduce from a wild to a tame or domestic state; to tame; to make gentle; as, to reclaim a hawk, an eagle or a wild beast.
To demand or challenge; to make a claim; a French use.

example.quote: If that were at an end, the States which made the cession, on a principle of federal compromise, would be apt when the motive of the grant had ceased, to reclaim the lands as a reversion.
